name: TabBar
title: TabBar
summary: The bottom tab bar of an ISM app: five equal tabs (Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More) that switch between the app's top-level sections.
whenToUse: Use on every root screen of dot.Bible and other ISM apps with three to five top-level sections.
Keep it visible on drilled-in screens unless the screen is full-screen reading or a modal flow.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it for in-page filters; use SegmentedControl or chips.
Do not put actions (Share, Give) in the tab bar; tabs only navigate.

anatomy.description: 84px including the home indicator area. Each tab is a 24px icon over an 11/600 label.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The tabs, in order. dot.Bible uses exactly five: Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled id of the active tab.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a tab is pressed.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Three to five tabs. dot.Bible uses exactly five in this order: Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More.

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Key of the current tab. Exactly one is active at all times.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the key of the tab pressed. Tabs only navigate; never put actions here.

props.name: safeAreaInsets
props.description: Safe-area insets. The bar adds `bottom` below the tabs so the home indicator never overlaps them.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation region.

variants.how: aria-current="page" (or .ap-is-active): Horizon Blue icon and label
.ap-dot 9px Horizon Blue with a 2px ring in the bar colour
keyboard focus ring inset (.ap-is-focus for specimens)

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Exactly five tabs in dot.Bible, always in this order: Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More.
One active tab at all times. Colour alone is not the cue: the label stays visible on every tab.
Badge dots and counts are Horizon Blue (`--blue-on-dark` on dark), never red. Red is reserved for errors.
Use the dot for "something new"; never show a number above 9 in a tab.
Tabs are at least 44px tall (52px here) and share the width equally.
Use outline icons at stroke 1.8; do not swap to filled icons for the active tab.
The bar sits on white with a top hairline (`--gray-200`); content scrolls under it.

accessibility: Wrap in `<nav aria-label="Main">`; mark the current tab with `aria-current="page"`.
When a tab has a dot, extend its name: `aria-label="More, new item"`.
Do not trap focus; Tab moves through the five tabs in order.
Labels never truncate; keep them to one short word.
content: Labels are one word, title case: Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More.
Translate labels with the app; keep them short in every language.
